related_questions.question: Can you look up Illinois court cases?

text_blocks.snippet: To find Illinois court cases, you can access electronic dockets through the Clerk of the Circuit Court of Cook County's website for Cook County cases. For statewide cases, including those from other counties, you can use the re:SearchIL website which is a statewide central document repository. Additionally, the Public Access to Court Electronic Records (PACER) system is available for accessing information from federal courts.

list.title: Federal Court Cases:
